T: The desk cops get the case. And the takeaway.
D: Two mismatched New York desk detectives finally get a real case and try to prove they are more than paperwork.
P: Serve the snacks when Allen and Terry leave the desk for the street.
S: Desk pop smoked salmon bagel bites
Mini bagels with caper dill cream cheese, smoked salmon, pickled onion

Toasted mini bagels spread with whipped caper and dill cream cheese, topped with smoked salmon, pickled red onion and a crack of pepper. Slice 1 red onion thin and cover with 80ml white vinegar, 1 tbsp sugar and a pinch of salt for 20 minutes. Beat 200g cream cheese with 1 tbsp chopped capers, 1 tbsp chopped dill and lemon zest. Split and toast 8 mini bagels. Spread each half with the cream cheese, fold on smoked salmon (200g total), top with drained pickled onion and dill and grind over pepper.
Crisp chickpea fritters with onion and spinach, mint yoghurt
Crisp spiced onion and spinach fritters in a chickpea batter, with mint yoghurt, as colourful as a peacock.
M: Lion versus tuna sesame tuna bowls
Seared tuna, avocado, edamame and cucumber over rice, wasabi soy

Sesame-crusted tuna seared rare and sliced over sushi rice with avocado, cucumber, edamame and pickled ginger, finished with a soy and wasabi dressing. Cook 2 cups sushi rice and season with 3 tbsp rice vinegar and 1 tbsp sugar. Coat 4 tuna steaks (600g) in 60g mixed sesame seeds. Sear in a very hot oiled pan 45 seconds a side and slice. Whisk 3 tbsp soy, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tsp sesame oil and half a tsp wasabi. Boil 200g frozen edamame 3 minutes. Build bowls with rice, tuna, sliced avocado, cucumber, edamame and pickled ginger and spoon over the dressing.
W: Fudgy dark chocolate brownies baked in a tin and cut in squares
Dense fudgy brownies cut into neat squares, the stash a by-the-book accountant cop keeps in his drawer.
K: Foamy bourbon sour with lemon, bitters and a cherry

Bourbon shaken hard with fresh lemon, sugar syrup and egg white into a silky foam, served over ice with a cherry and a few drops of bitters. For each drink, put 50ml bourbon, 25ml lemon juice, 20ml sugar syrup and half an egg white (2 egg whites total) in a shaker. Shake without ice for 10 seconds to build the foam, then add ice and shake hard for 10 seconds more. Strain over fresh ice in a rocks glass. Add 3 drops of aromatic bitters on the foam and a cherry. For non-drinkers, swap the bourbon for cold black tea.
